hero.title: Move and manage your records
hero.subtitle: Import · export · delete
hero.speech: Before deleting anything important, export a backup first.

import.body: Import a summary from another AI or a previous personality test result. The content is sorted and saved in your records.

export.body: Copy your saved records from the knowledge store as one text file. Use it as a backup or take it to another tool.

delete.body: Delete one kind, or everything at once. Deletion can't be undone, so export first.

device.body: Display settings and first-use tips are saved only on this device. They reset when you change devices or clear app data. Your saved records are separate.
